oc_status.note: OC is not yet received for the project.

amount.interest_rate_description: 10.4% per annum minus pre EMI interest paid by the respondents

deadline.event: possession of the flat is offered with OC

reliefs.reasoning: Respondent failed to hand over possession by the agreed date (30.06.2017). The delay cannot be excused by promoter's unilateral revision of completion date or force majeure reasons for more than six months. Complainant is entitled to interest on the consideration paid from 01.07.2017 till possession with OC, at 2% above SBI's highest MCLR (8.4% + 2% = 10.4%) after deducting pre-EMI interest paid by respondents.
Complainant is entitled to get Rs. 20,000/- towards the cost of the complaint.

supplementary_proceedings.reasoning: The respondent failed to comply with the previous order regarding interest payment. A credit note was promised but not issued. The respondent did not object to the issuance of the warrant. The MahaRERA decided to issue a recovery warrant under Section 40(1) of RERA.

The MahaRERA is forwarding the recovery warrant under Section 40(1) of RERA for its execution by the Collector due to the respondent's failure to comply with the previous order. The Collector is requested to execute the warrant and inform MahaRERA upon realization of the amount.

extraction_notes: The principal amount (Rs. 31,88,399/-) is specified as the base for interest calculation under delay interest relief, not as a direct refund amount. The interest rate of 10.4% is derived from '2% above SBI's highest MCLR which is currently 8.4%' as stated on page 13. The coram for the primary order is Shri B.D. Kapadnis, while for the non-compliance application it was Dr. Vasant Prabhu.
